scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @charts-plus/demo && npm run build -w @charts-plus/perf-harness
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-core && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-text && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-interaction && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-indicators && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-drawings && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-render-webgpu && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-render-canvas2d && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart-transforms && npm run build -w @charts-plus/chart
scripts.test:playwright:smoke: npm run test:playwright -w @charts-plus/perf-harness -- tests/smoke.spec.ts tests/perf-invariants.spec.ts tests/visual.spec.ts tests/leak.spec.ts
